notes.title: Several updates!
notes.content:
Controller support!
You can now play the game with any(?) controller (Does not work with UI, but gameplay itself is possible)

Better UI
Removed text that covered some of the screen, added a new spot where you can see the game controls in the pause menu.

Better optimization
Removed unnecessaries, adjusted scripts so that few things required processing resources.

Better chain physics
Improved the chains on the baskets to be better!

notes.title: Minor UI patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug where when switching levels the Disc information on the left when you spawn a disc stopped populating.

notes.title: Cool new features!
notes.content:
Added an inventory system and the start of what will become the store system.
As is stands the player now has excess of 9 discs on every level. When opening a level, your inventory tab will automatically open. You can click-and-drag each disc to rearrange the order. The top 9 discs are associated with hotkeys 1-9.

Also added AI controlled animals to 1 map and made minor updates to a couple of maps.

notes.title: Better physics and disc tracking and some hidden stuff
notes.content:
This update is another update to the flight physics of the disc to try to get even closer to realistic flight pathing. In addition, added a 'trail' to the disc so you can actually see it moving through the air to have a better idea of where it went.

Hidden stuff:
Started to build the backend to the in-game shop to buy and use more discs. For those opposed to microtransactions, good news, we will NEVER have micro transactions. You will earn in game cash by performance to get these discs. Future maps will always be free to current game owners. The base price of the game might go up as features are added.

notes.title: Multiple minor updates
notes.content:
Updated:
Physics to behave more like a disc should
Increased maximum throw strength
Adjusted UI to make the center of the screen more clean

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.content:
UI Improvements:
On one world hitting escape opened the weather control tool. This has been removed
When throwing a disc, the distance between you and the disc was shown as a long digit of numbers in the central UI text. In an effort for cleaner UI, this has been removed. The disc can now be found using the white spec on the minimap after throwing the disc.
Added the ability to click "H" to hide/show the instructions text as appropriate to reduce clutter on the screen for knowledgeable players.
